units.source_text: 我想死，強烈地想死，一切都無法挽回，

en.t: I want to die, I desperately want to die; everything is beyond repair,

units.source_text: 無論做什麼事，怎麼做都只是徒勞一場，徒增恥辱而已。

en.t: No matter what I do, or how I do it, it is only futile and only adds to my shame.

units.source_text: 騎自行車去青葉瀑布的願望已蕩然無存，

en.t: The wish to ride a bicycle to Aoba Falls had vanished completely,

units.source_text: 有的只是在汙穢的罪惡上重疊可恥的罪惡，增添苦惱。

en.t: All that remained was to pile shameful sins upon filthy sins and add to my suffering.

units.source_text: 我想死，強烈地想死，活著本身就是罪惡的根源。

en.t: I want to die, I desperately want to die; being alive itself is the root of sin.

units.source_text: 雖然這麼想，但還是依然近乎瘋狂地往返於公寓與藥店之間。

en.t: Though I thought this, I still kept going back and forth between the apartment and the pharmacy almost in a frenzy.

units.source_text: 不論做再多工作，因為藥品的使用量也隨之增加，所積欠的藥費已高得驚人，

en.t: No matter how much work I did, my use of medicine increased along with it, and the drugstore debt I had run up became astonishingly high,

units.source_text: 老闆娘見到我就兩眼含淚，而我也禁不住潸然落淚。

en.t: When the proprietress saw me, tears filled her eyes, and I too could not help but weep.
